owner_goal.purpose: Historical source-faithful astrology as one part of 16 traditions followed by frozen prospective blind person-level outcome tests with decoys and nonastrology controls

source.edition: F. Boll / E. Boer, Greek Tetrabiblos IV.5, Perseus edition text
minimal_greek_anchors: ἐπὶ μὲν τῶν ἀνδρῶν ἀφορᾶν δεῖ τὴν σελήνην
ἐπὶ δὲ τῶν γυναικῶν ἀφορᾶν δεῖ τὸν ἥλιον
source.historical_gender_binaries_scope: Men->Moon; women->Sun, as worded in transmitted text; categories not inferred for actual participants
source_qualifications: The Moon in bicorporeal OR multiform sign OR applying to multiple planets in same sign is translated as multiple marriages; the source also has separate monomorphic-or-single-application one-marriage clauses
The Sun's corresponding passage uses bicorporeal/multiform signs or configuration with several oriental planets
Multiple disjunctive clauses may overlap and even produce contradictory outputs if naively executed independently
A single positive bicorporeal-sign subrule is not an exclusive natal or personality prediction
The ancient Greek speaks of lawful cohabitation/marriage in its own historical conditions, not modern legal marriage certificates or a specific age cutoff
unimplemented_source_families: multiform signs not identical to Ptolemy 4 bicorporeal
marriage frequency and timing other clauses

research_classifier.source_bicorporality_positive_outcome: >1 lawful marriage, no specific cutoff in the source
research_classifier.source_negative_branch: NO_ASSERTION_FROM_THIS_SUBRULE; never predict exactly one marriage merely because Moon/Sun outside four signs
research_classifier.moon_uses_tropical_longitude_0_360: tropical convention consistent with prior project source-lane; explicit choice rather than tested against results

outcome_human_study_DRAFT.primary_endpoint_PROPOSED: Two or more distinct legally or legally equivalent recognized unions by attained age 50
outcome_human_study_DRAFT.non_astrological_comparator: Cohort/region/law/sex group/education/age-aware risk model, optionally full birth-month seasonality; choose before seeing chart-associated responses
outcome_human_study_DRAFT.cohort_selection: Recruit adults independently of marriage history, natal placements and belief in astrology; age >=50 proposed analytic maturity cutoff, not ancient source stipulation
outcome_human_study_DRAFT.source_gender_scope: Ptolemy's male-text arm primary; Sun female-text arm secondary, not mechanically generalized to modern identity categories without participant choice/approval
outcome_human_study_DRAFT.outcome_sensitivity: Legal civil marriage count vs customary/religious legal equivalents vs cohabitation must remain separate registered sensitivity definitions
outcome_human_study_DRAFT.potential_censoring: Death, incomplete marriage records and age at observation must be addressed
outcome_human_study_DRAFT.unknown_information: No records, ambiguous customary union definition, insufficient source birth window - UNRESOLVED not positive

practical_feasibility.direct_consequence: Marriage-count outcome is feasible via consenting individual response/records, whereas open historical military files generally cannot verify battle participation and often lack birth time. Neither currently has an actual consenting blinded cohort.
